data.one_liner: Flat UI icon pack with 2,988 SVG icons across 6 styles based on Flaticon UIcons.
data.what_it_does: Provides 2,988 SVG icons in six styles (regular, bold, and solid weights with rounded or straight corners). Icons adapt to ambient IconThemes and support semantic labels for screen readers.
use_when: You need flat UI style icons in your Flutter application
You want icons that automatically follow ambient IconTheme colors and sizes
avoid_when: You want standard Material Design icons (use material_symbols_icons)
strengths: Large icon library with multiple weights and corner styles
First-class IconTheme and accessibility support out of the box
weaknesses: Bundles all 2,988 SVGs as assets (~12 MB uncompressed) rather than a tree-shaken font

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the widely used Font Awesome icon set instead of Flaticon UIcons.

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer clean, minimalist Lucide vector icons.

alternatives.name: material_symbols_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want Google's official Material Symbols icon set.
